I updated `scripts/register-tasks.ps1`, but the live task is still at 02:00. Windows denied the change.

- **Script:** the `BackupTime` default and its help text now say `03:30` instead of `02:00`. It's an uncommitted edit on `master`. I didn't run the script and added no tests, since it has none.
- **Live task:** `Set-ScheduledTask` on `\WslAutomation\WSL-Backup` returned `Access is denied` (HRESULT 0x80070005). The task runs with `-RunLevel Highest`, and PowerShell launched from WSL has a non-elevated token, so it can't modify it. I stopped there. I didn't try `Start-Process -Verb RunAs` or `schtasks`, because working around the elevation boundary is your call.

To finish it, open an elevated (Run as administrator) PowerShell on Windows and run one of these:

```powershell
# Re-register from the repo script (path is wherever the repo is checked out on Windows)
pwsh -File <repo>\scripts\register-tasks.ps1

# or change only the trigger
Set-ScheduledTask -TaskPath "\WslAutomation\" -TaskName "WSL-Backup" `
  -Trigger (New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -Daily -At 03:30)
```

If you'd rather I retry from an already-elevated session, tell me. I haven't committed anything.
